TABLE_MODE.Controls.Title: Table Mode
TABLE_MODE.Controls.ToggleViewbox: Toggle Viewbox (drag to move, bottom-right handle to resize)
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttUser.Name: VTT User
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttUser.Hint: The Foundry user whose client renders on the table TV. Viewport commands are sent to this user. GM accounts are excluded; Assistant GM is allowed.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttAspect.Name: VTT Screen Aspect Ratio
TABLE_MODE.Settings.VttAspect.Hint: Locks the viewbox to this aspect ratio. Use 'Auto' to detect the VTT client's actual screen. Override if auto-detection gives wrong results.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.AnimationDuration.Hi: Duration of the pan/zoom animation when the VTT client receives a viewport sync.
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideUi.Name: Hide VTT UI (minimal canvas view)
TABLE_MODE.Settings.HideUi.Hint: Hides all UI chrome on the VTT client — sidebar, chat, scene navigation, player list, hotbar, scene controls, logo, pause indicator. Applies to the VTT client only. GM UI is not affected.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.NoVttUser: Table Mode: no VTT user selected. Set one in module settings first.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.Synced: Table Mode: viewport synced to VTT.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.ReloadSent: Table Mode: reload command sent to VTT client.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.NoNotes: Table Mode: no map notes on this scene.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.NoLinkedEntries: Table Mode: no map notes have a linked journal entry.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.BulkToggleFaile: Table Mode: bulk note toggle failed — see console.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.NotesHidden: Table Mode: hidden {count} note target(s) from players.
TABLE_MODE.Notifications.NotesShown: Table Mode: shown {count} note target(s) to players.
TABLE_MODE.Controls.ReloadEmbed: Reload TV Embed (after Homebrewery edits, etc.)
TABLE_MODE.EmbedUrl.FieldLabel: Push to TV as iframe (overrides journal push)
TABLE_MODE.EmbedUrl.FieldHint: When set, the TV-icon pushes this URL as a full-screen iframe instead of opening the journal sheet on the VTT client. Use Homebrewery share links, image URLs, or any embeddable page.
TABLE_MODE.EmbedUrl.NoUrlSet: Table Mode: no embed URL set on this page.
TABLE_MODE.EmbedUrl.NothingToReload: Table Mode: no active TV embed to reload.
